claims.assertion: Mari Swa says she and others saw similarities between Temmer’s hurricane and Beryl; some Taygetans suspected artificial or dimensional links.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She reports differing suspicions and says weather control complicates causal assessment.

claims.assertion: Gori’el reports that Alfratean hosts urged attendees to rely on Federation information and keep Earth isolated until humanity develops suitable ethics.
claims.speaker: Gori’el
claims.qualifiers: He says his questions were interrupted or ignored during the meeting.

claims.assertion: Mari says the Taygetan High Council told her Alenym had abdicated, making Mari the new queen.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa

review_flags: This source includes unverified claims about weather manipulation, extraterrestrial diplomacy, and public political events.
coverage_gaps: Other passages discuss the Sadicleya’s arrival and Mari’s interpretation of a political assassination attempt.
